title: Opening chatter and setting up the Louis Armstrong interview
summary: Interviewers joke about playing piano, check recording levels, and say the interview is mainly about Punch's association with Louis Armstrong.

blocks.x: I played piano with Ruth Lowe the other day. You know the joke, can you play piano? I don't know, I never tried. I was sitting down there, I know three chords on the piano, and Ruth Lowe and Morgan were there, and there was a photographer there, so I started playing away on the piano. And I played the, you know, in C, I played C, G, and F, you know, C, F, and G, you know, in the right order sometimes, and sometimes in time, it was fun.
It doesn't fix me, you know. I think...
Let me know if I'm over-modulating, man.
Okay, what do you want to ask, Beth?
She's got to get to that.
Mostly just, I guess, about your association with Louis Armstrong,
since you're both sick right now.
